description: Test whether the H287 pocket is enriched for the most conserved acn1 residues and map its geometry
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import hypergeom
meta=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/O74380",timeout=60).json()[0]
pdb=requests.get(meta["pdbUrl"],timeout=60).text
at={}
for l in pdb.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM"):
        res=int(l[22:26]); nm=l[12:16].strip(); el=l[76:78].strip()
        xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]); b=float(l[60:66])
        at.setdefault(res,{"side":[],"ca":None,"plddt":b,"aa":l[17:20]})
        if nm=="CA": at[res]["ca"]=xyz
        if nm not in ("N","CA","C","O") and el!="H": at[res]["side"].append(xyz)
def mind(a,b):
    A=np.array(at[a]["side"]); B=np.array(at[b]["side"])
    return np.sqrt(((A[:,None,:]-B[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)).min()
pocket=[r for r in at if r!=287 and at[r]["side"] and abs(r-287)>3 and mind(287,r)<8]
top12=[1,27,136,245,249,250,257,264,280,283,287,328]
ov=[r for r in pocket if r in top12]
p=hypergeom.sf(len(ov)-1, 357, len(top12), len(pocket))
print(f"pocket residues (<8 A of H287, |i-287|>3): {len(pocket)}")
print(f"overlap with the 12 most conserved acn1 positions: {sorted(ov)}  hypergeometric p = {p:.2e}")

sel=[245,249,250,253,257,283,287,291,302,306,73,77]
sel=sorted(set(sel))
D=np.array([[mind(a,b) if a!=b else 0 for b in sel] for a in sel])
cons={245:0.96,249:0.96,250:0.84,257:0.82,283:0.87,287:0.91}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,6),gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.05,1]})
im=ax[0].imshow(D,cmap="viridis_r",vmin=0,vmax=14)
lab=[f"{at[r]['aa'].title()}{r}" for r in sel]
ax[0].set_xticks(range(len(sel))); ax[0].set_xticklabels(lab,rotation=90,fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_yticks(range(len(sel))); ax[0].set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=9)
for i in range(len(sel)):
    for j in range(len(sel)):
        ax[0].text(j,i,f"{D[i,j]:.1f}",ha='center',va='center',fontsize=7,
                   color="white" if D[i,j]<7 else "black")
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax[0],label="min side-chain heavy-atom distance (A)",fraction=.046)
ax[0].set_title("A. Pocket geometry in AlphaFold model AF-O74380-F1 v6",fontsize=11,loc='left')
ca=np.array([at[r]["ca"] for r in sel]); c=ca.mean(0)
u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(ca-c); xy=(ca-c)@vt[:2].T
colr=["#c0392b" if r in (250,287) else ("#2a7fb8" if r in cons else "#95a5a6") for r in sel]
ax[1].scatter(xy[:,0],xy[:,1],s=[260 if r in cons else 120 for r in sel],c=colr,zorder=3,edgecolor='white')
for (x,y),r in zip(xy,sel):
    ax[1].annotate(f"{at[r]['aa'].title()}{r}"+(f"\n{cons[r]:.2f}" if r in cons else ""),
                   (x,y),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(0,13),ha='center',fontsize=9)
i250,i287=sel.index(250),sel.index(287)
ax[1].plot(xy[[i250,i287],0],xy[[i250,i287],1],'k-',lw=2,zorder=2)
ax[1].annotate("4.65 A",xy=xy[[i250,i287]].mean(0),fontsize=10,ha='center',
               bbox=dict(boxstyle="round",fc="white",ec="none"))
ax[1].set_title("B. Same residues projected on their first 2 principal axes\n(blue labels give conservation across 45 homologs)",fontsize=11,loc='left')
ax[1].set_xlabel("PC1 (A)"); ax[1].set_ylabel("PC2 (A)")
for s_ in ['top','right']: ax[1].spines[s_].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
